name: app-mango-product-card-light-and-photo-variants
title: Mango Product Card Variants
whatItIs: Two versions of a product card for Alphonso mangoes: a white card with a photo, price tag and brown Add to cart button, and a full-bleed photo card with a glassy overlay and white button.
whatItMeans: Strong product photography drives the mood, and the two variants show a system with range. Brown and gold keep the fruit warm.
techniques: Full-bleed photo card with text over a color-graded gradient
Brown accent chosen from the product itself
Small pill badges (Best Seller, 9 left) for scarcity
Discount tag on the image corner
Same content in two layouts to compare

vocabulary.definition: A card whose background is the image itself.
A label like '9 left' encouraging action.
Taking UI colors from the product photo.
